integrity: Exact analytic identities and all-domain monotonicity establish the theorem. A standalone SymPy checker verifies symbolic algebra and finite exact-rational examples; finite diagnostics are not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two independent geometric parents; the finite-support universality threshold assumes the same consecutive support. No classification for three or more geometric parents. Bibliographic priority not independently certified.
title: A single curvature reversal for heterogeneous geometric maxima and the sharp four-point threshold
